The surface texture is unevenly noisy and 'melted' in places, lacking the crisp, smooth finish of injection-molded plastic. Edges of the internal spools bleed into the casing.
The geometric precision of the rectangular prism degrades at the edges, with slight warping and softness that doesn't match optical blur alone.
